confusion.configuration: bge-large-en-v1.5+logreg + LLM on 70.1% of traffic, rule chosen per fold (class_aware/confidence)

routing.verdict: routing can add at most 20.1% (items only the LLM gets right) and risks 13.6% (items only the free arm gets right); 6.4% is out of reach for both

G3_roc_dominance.verdict: G3 pass: at least one pair is not ROC-ordered, so some genuine complementarity exists.

G4_pool_diversity.verdict: G4 pass: members disagree on 28.2% of items.

G5_class_advantage.verdict: G5 FAIL: per-class advantage is flat (spread 0.0207); a class-aware SELECTION layer has nothing to act on. Budget-constrained class-aware allocation is a separate rule, reported on the dial regardless.

G7_base_rate_dominance.verdict: G7 pass: every class's vote is right more often than not (worst 70.3%).

vs_expert.note: G6: +0.0000 is inside the +/-0.0062 this dataset can resolve -- not a difference

G8_per_class_headroom.verdict: G8 FAIL: with the answers in hand a per-class threshold gains -0.0125 at a 70% budget, but shuffled classes buy -0.0183 of that -- only +0.0058 is real, inside the +/-0.0062 this dataset resolves. No estimator recovers headroom that is not there.

deslib.verdict: no DESlib method beats the best single model (bge-large-en-v1.5+logreg)

non_inferiority.verdict: clearly worse by more than the 2% margin

cheapest_equivalent.note: 50.0% of traffic scores 0.8151 via confidence, 0.0041 BELOW the best point and inside the +/-0.0062 this dataset resolves

recommendation.why: G5 FAIL: per-class advantage is flat (spread 0.0207); a class-aware SELECTION layer has nothing to act on. Budget-constrained class-aware allocation is a separate rule, reported on the dial regardless.

notes: G1: a constant '0' predictor scores 0.8883 accuracy. Raw accuracy ranks systems by closeness to degenerate prediction on this dataset -- headline metric forced to balanced accuracy.
G2: 257 rows (2.40%) share text with another row; CV is grouped so copies cannot straddle a fold.
